liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): Crosby plays 12-string guitar on the Truckin' > Other One > Morning Dew sequence; listen closely; Truckin' through to Morning Dew is the reviewer's highlight [9][17][18]
- **Playin' in the Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Playin' well jammed; The Playin' jam is called among the best ever [9][14]
- **Truckin'** (2 reviews): Truckin' running into The Other One lasts about 55 minutes; Over 43 straight minutes of jamming run from Bobby's last 'Get back truckin' on' line to 'Spanish Lady' [7][14]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Phil and Bill open the Other One; Jerry closes it with an 'enlightenment' jam around 20:51 [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **NYE Countdown**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 6 archived performances [19]
- **KSAN's DJ, El Paso**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **equipment malfunction**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **Drums and Bass**: rare: 5 archived performances [19]
- **thanks Bill Graham**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-12-31.sbd.bertha-ashley.26559.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 34 songs; 226 min; rated 4.55/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd72-12-31.prefm.vernon.20559.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 30 songs; 226 min; rated 4.54/5 by 28 [3]. Said about its sound: Vault reels are somewhat low in volume but clean and pure; Reviewer finds the mix sterile; Sound is good enough to give an idea of the concert [7][12][18]
- **gd1972-12-31.sbd.prefm.wier.6340.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 202 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [5]
- **gd1972-12-31.sbd.unknown.1563.sbefail.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 202 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]

## Around the show

- The countdown finishes and the band launches straight into Around and Around [11]
- Reviewer attended at age 16; David Crosby sat in for part of the Truckin' to Morning Dew stretch [15]
- David Crosby played on The Other One and/or Morning Dew, and returned for Casey Jones [2]
- The bill also included NRPS and Sons of Champlin; the source is a KSAN FM broadcast [2]
- David Crosby joined for the second part of The Other One and Morning Dew [5]
- David Crosby joined for the second part of The Other One and Morning Dew [6]
- Final show of 1972, described as the first truly incredible year in Dead history, with 1969 as a possible rival [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-12-31.sbd.bertha-ashley.26559.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by J. Ashely; source: SBD (Pre-FM) > Master Reel [1]. Also: Main source is Vault pre-FM reels via DAT, patched from the pre-FM KSAN reel; Marc Pujol did DAT transfer, Matt Vernon edited; Remastered with a dual-DAW setup nicknamed Bertha, completed August 18, 2004 [1]
- **gd72-12-31.prefm.vernon.20559.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Newer Vault reel transfer is more complete than the earlier circulating pre-FM KSAN reel copy, which went through DAT and SHN [7]
- **gd1972-12-31.sbd.prefm.wier.6340.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charles Wier; source: Pre-FM KSAN Reel > DAT > SHN [5]. Also: Tracks restored to original order; sector boundary problems fixed with Shntool; clips at start of Candyman, Promised Land, Big River on all copies [5]
- **gd1972-12-31.sbd.unknown.1563.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by unknown; source: Pre-FM KSAN Reel > DAT > .SHN. [6]. Also: Clips at the start of Candyman, Promised Land and Big River appear on every circulating copy [6]
